text:
liz: Customer (AcmeCorp) reporting intermittent 502s to hosted API in us-west starting ~11:05 PST. They say it only happens when a tenant-routing header is present. Trace id: trc-8f3a-11. Can we triage?

ops-bot: alert: edge-gateway/us-west 502-rate +120% at 11:04, top path /v1/generate, p50 latency unchanged :eyes:

simon: Thanks — can you paste the edge logs and full request headers (sanitized)? any recent deploys?

liz: logs pasted below (redacted):

```
[11:05:12] envoy[pid=2345] "upstream reset" code=PROTOCOL_ERROR reason="header size" trace=trc-8f3a-11
[11:05:12] proxy: returning 502 to client, upstream returned error
[11:05:13] request-id=trc-8f3a-11 src=10.2.1.45 dst=edge-usw-01
```

Request headers (sanitized):
```
:method: POST
:path: /v1/generate
host: api.redwood.com
authorization: Bearer <redacted>
X-Tenant-ID: tenant-acme
X-Tenant-Meta: {"region":"us-west","env":"prod", "features": [ ... huge blob ... ]}
Content-Type: application/json
```

Note: X-Tenant-Meta is a large JSON string ~18KB per customer report.

maya: there's been a canary envoy build pushed at 11:03 with new compile-time header size limits (attempt to tighten memory). rolling back that change would be my first try.

simon: repro steps I used locally to confirm:
```
LONG_HDR=$(python -c 'print("x"*18500)')
curl -v -H "X-Tenant-Meta: $LONG_HDR" -H "Authorization: Bearer <tok>" \
  https://edge-usw.api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Result: immediate 502 with same envoy log "header size" in local test.

maya: action: rolled back envoy canary at 11:20 (edge-usw-*) to previous stable. Pragmatic mitigation: drop oversized non-essential headers at edge (return 400) until we have header-shaping; will open infra ticket.

simon: temporary doc snippet for support to give customers: "If you send metadata headers >16KB the gateway may reject the request — please move large tenant metadata to payload or a tenant config store. We're rolling back a config change; we will follow up with a hard limit and better error (400) so failures don't appear as 502."

liz: Customer confirmed errors subsided after 11:22. Will advise Acme to move heavy metadata out of headers. Follow-ups:
- infra ticket: INFRA-3921 (add header sanitizer & explicit 413/400)
- eng-runtime: evaluate header size defaults in envoy/nginx images

maya: note for postmortem: correlate with deploy at 11:03 and canary traffic split 5% -> 100% by 11:10; window allowed many requests with large headers to hit canary. We'll add deploy gate for header limits. :white_check_mark:
